nom: Lancôme Crème Radiance Clarifying Cream-to-Foam Cleanser

avis.texte: I had a sample bottle of this and it lasted sooo long - like a few minths if not, longer! Luxurious feel & gives a good, deep clean!

I've used it on and off for over ten years. It is a product I come back to over and over again, regardless of the price, which keeps increasing year after year since it was in the $20s range (maybe even lower). It cleans well, is super effective, and a tiny drop with water foams up efficiently and effortlessly. I love using it in the evening after oil-cleaning my makeup. Morning is fine, too; it doesn't over-dry the skin. It doesn't leave any weird feelings afterwards. Beautiful balance for my combination-dry skin. I will keep buying it no matter how the price changes.

This cleanser feels so nice and luxurious! It takes of my makup, oil and dirt while leaving me skin nice and glowy. It penetrates into pores, dissolves impurities. Has an antitoxidant white lotus flower, Rose de France rosewater.

I have extremely sensitive skin. Ive tried countless cleansers that claim they're good for sensitive skin, only to be left with burning skin while cleansing, and then redness and tight dry skin upon drying. Tried this cleanser on a whim when I received it as a gift, and fell in love. A tiny bit really does go a long way, and the creamy lather feels good on my skin. It removes makeup effortlessly and my skin has truly never looked better. No breakouts, no redness, and no burning or tight skin after. This one is going to be staying with me for the long haul, and I really couldnt recommend it enough.

I discovered this face wash in college, I'm 33 now and I still love it! It cleans your face so well and clears it of all makeup and dirt. It has a scent, and it ALWAYS has. For many of us scents are not a big deal, it honestly makes this product feel more luxe to me personally and does not negatively affect my skin. It also goes away right after you wash your face. For a few months about 10 years ago I stopped using it and my face was breaking out so bad. Once I got back to using this my face cleared completely after a few weeks. Also you need only a LITTLE bit. I've had tubes of this last me 6 or more months and I wash my face daily. I'm talking a pea sized amount you lather up and wash your face with. The people complaining of residue are using way too much. LOVE LOVE this face wash so much and always keep multiple backups of it. It's a steep price but trust me it's so concentrated it lasts way more than diluted liquidy face washes.

Why did you change this product?! I have been using this product for 5+ years if not longer. Many women in my family also use this product. Why why why change it?! The formula is not the same and they added a scent. Why why why :( I have super sensitive skin and struggle to find skincare products that work for me. All of the reasons i loved this cleanser are now gone. The old one was so light and airy and was perfect as an end of day cleanser or a morning cleanser. It took my makeup off without stripping my skin dry. It was easy to dispense and lathered beautifully. This new one is sticky, does not lather at all, harder to dispense when I have makeup remover and water on my face / eyes, its SCENTED (why?!), sticky (again - why sticky?!), and leaves my face feeling unclean and irritated. I will not be repurchasing and will not recommend this product to anyone. I will let everyone I know who uses this product to start searching for a new option. Again I have been buying this product in bulk for years so this is truly devastating to me! Lancome PLEASE bring back the old product! Please!

avis.titre: This is THE one cleanser I love
avis.texte: Everything about Crème Radiance Cleanser is just right for me. It soothes my skin, the cream to foam feature is easy to use with any applicator (wash cloth, fingers, etc), and a tiny bit goes a very long way. I actually look forward to using it at the end of the day because it feels so good.

avis.titre: Love the cleanser, hate the packaging.
avis.texte: I love the cleanser itself but it's so hard to get it out of the tube. I typically cut it open and transfer the cleanser to a jar so I can just scoop it out. Otherwise so much would be discarded.

I use Clinique Take the Day Off to remove my makeup, rinse my face, then use a pea sized amount of this cleanser. It foams beautifully and leaves my skin feeling clean and hydrated. 10/10 recommend. Do not even flinch at the price because it lasts a really long time.

Do not let the ounces to price tag ratio scare you!!! A little goes a long way!!! I have had this for a month now and I have barely made a dent! Its super gentle. It works really well on my dry, acne prone sensitive skin!!! Make sure you wet your face good before applying.

I have used many expensive cleansers over the years and this one continues to be the best cleanser I have ever used. It leaves my face feeling so clear and smooth when done and has not given me any issues with breakouts.
After trying every face wash over the past years this is my go to product! My face never felt to soft, clean and glowing. I would buy this product over and over again

avis.titre: Have used this for many years
avis.texte: Love it and my skin shows how being consistent over long periods of time provides excellent long term results

If this issupposed to be removing makeup, even waterproof, wouldnt you think to use it on the eye area? That is what i did to remove my shadows, liner, and mascara and immediately regretted. This burns my eyes!!! I had to wash it off quickly. Be careful!!!
I love everything about this foam cleanser. It makes my skin feel soft, the smell is amazing and it cleanes so well. I love the pink and the blue.
I have very sensitive skin; this is the only cleanser I can use. It always leaves my face feeling clean.
It cleans without drying out my skin. The texture is good as well.
Love this product, very effective, see the difference right away

avis.titre: The only facial cleanser I use! Great product.
avis.texte: Excellent product and lasts a long time—a little goes a long way. This is the only facial cleanser I will use these days! Totally worth the price.
This face wash is creamy, gentle and effectively removes dirt and makeup residue. I really like it.

Does not strip my skin but gets the good done right. You need just a pea size to get a great lather. My skin has improved so much with just this cleanser alone. I don't care for the Rose cleanser but adore this one!
Love this face wash! I keep it in the shower. I've used it for several years.

avis.titre: A little goes a long way
avis.texte: I love this cream rinse. You only need a dime size and it removes all makeup other than eye of course. I have been using this for over 15 years and it is still my favorite cream rinse.
This cleanser is good for all skin types. It doesnt dry my face and smells nice.

avis.titre: Creme Radiance Leaves My Face Clean and Smooth
avis.texte: Creme Radiance leaves my face clean and smooth. It's gentle foaming cream cleanses so well! I have used it for many years. At 71, I have a face that looks 50 or 60.
Make my skin so soft and clean. It is smooth and smell so good.
This cleanser cleans and refreshes my face, takes off every bit of makeup and is gentle enough for my sensitive skin.
Cleanser makes a great lather and makes my skin feel very clean

I've used many make up removing products over the years and have never switched once I started using this one. It is amazing at removing make up never having to apply a second lather to clean. It's just perfect. Only requires a small amount and my skin is so smooth and I've never had an issue with a breakout once switching to this cleanser

Are you getting rid of this product as well? I don't understand why Lancome is discontinuing all of its best products. Rouge in Love lipstick, the gel eyeliner, Grandiose eyeliner, the entire Visionaire line of products, changed the formula for Teint Idole, and now this. You are forcing people to use other brands. I have used all of the Visionaire products for years. I realized it was discontinued and when I ran out I ordered Renergie, which is no substitute as it does not work on the same concerns. In just a few months my skin has drastically changed and is now beginning to show lines around the eyes and on my forehead. Genifique eye and Renergie are not beneficial to everyone. Stop discontinuing good products.

avis.titre: I only use Lancôme skincare products and makeup. !
avis.texte: Best face wash, my face always feels refreshed after I use it.
This face does it all, wash your face and leaves it feeling fresh.
This product is hard an awkward to get product out of the tube. The Mousse Radiance pump was far better. Please bring it back.

I have other facial cleanser and this one is the one I always repurchase. I have combination oily skin and this product helps reduce it. I always feel clean and it washes away my makeup or any impurities. A little goes a long way which is great, so this product lasts longer even when using it once or twice a day.

This is my go-to cleanser. It deep cleans and takes off make up without being harsh or drying. It is great prep for the rest of my skin care routine. I only need a little, so it lasts a really long time. I love it so much!

avis.titre: Best product to clean your face
avis.texte: I used this cream for 2 years now and smells so good also my face feels so good every time I used it . I love it!
I would highly recommend this product for cleansing your face. My face feels clean, but not dry and you only use a small amount to get your desired effect. Love it!!
A little goes a long way! I use a soft bristle face brush to foam it up. My skin never looked better.
I got this to replace my previous foamy cleanser which is no longer available. It makes a nice lather and cleanses thoroughly. Thanks to my Lancôme advisor for suggesting it
I have used Crème Radiance Cream to Foam Cleanser for almost 30 years and I am still very happy with this product as a cleanser and it doesn't dry out my skin.

avis.titre: Perfect cleanser for all skin types
avis.texte: Great lather, moisturizing and easily rinsed away. Leaves my skin soft and clean. Great price too

The product is impossible to squeeze out of the tube. Worse substitute for the Radiance Mousse which was the best cleanser ever. So disappointed that a Lancome discontinued that product which I used for years.
This is my favorite facial cleanser of all time. The formula is thick and a little bit goes a long way. It takes all of my makeup off and leaves my skin feeling clean but not overly dried out.
Lancôme's cleanser has become my new absolute favorite. It leaves my face moisturized and never dry at all. It takes the tiniest amount for my face, so it lasts a very long time. Great price as well.
It takes a tiny amount to cleanse your skin. My face feels so clean and tighter, with each use! So glad I found this!
I've been using this product for more than five years one of the best products I've ever used

avis.titre: Best daily face wash ever used
avis.texte: I use the tiniest little pea size amount in the shower to wash my face and neck, a little goes a long way. Silky and smells great. I have combo oily and dry skin, doesn't irritate me. Face feels soft and clean without being greasy or dry I pair this with my daily moisturizer.
This is the only cleanser I'll use. It only takes a tiny amount to lather up your face so it last a long time. Doesn't leave my skin feeling dry or pulled. I love it!
I love this primer. You only have to use about 1/2 pump to do your whole face. It does make my foundation go on smoother & last longer.
Don't stop making this cleanser.... I have been using this for over 20 years and would never use anything else

avis.titre: Awesome face wash for dry or oily skin
avis.texte: Use this daily as a face wash. In winter dryer skin works wonderful. In the summer oily skin and help clean out the large pores. Love it
Didn't like it, very thick and hard to remove. Very thick, to me it was old. Returning it.
Feel very clean and refresh after washing my face, not feel dry
Noticeable improvement in fine lines and wrinkles. Great choice for oily combination skin.

avis.titre: Been using this awesome cleanser for many years!
avis.texte: I love how clean my face is after using this product. It foams up nicely and my face feels great after I'm done with my routine.

I love this cleanser! It smells good and it works with getting off makeup. You only need a drop mixed with water and it lathers something crazy! Highly recommend.
I used this cleanser as a replacement to the foam cleanser that was discontinued. 4 stars because I prefer the foam. It's creamy and seems to be a reasonable replacement.
Creamy cleanser isn't as good or effective as the discontinued products of Lancome. It doesn't come close to comparing. On the other hand it's good. I'll look elsewhere.
I've been using this cleanser for years. It removes all make up, leaves my face fresh and clean and it doesn't leave it dry
Washes away all of my makeup completely leaving my face feeling clean and supple
It leaves my skin soft, clean and with a refreshing sensation. I love it. It doesn't dry out my skin
this cleanser is an old standby for me. It washes away make-up and build up from hard water from shower.

I love how you only need a little bit and it really washes all makeup and dirt off your face. My face feels so clean and fresh after I use it.

avis.texte: This has been my everyday cleanser for over 20 years. It doesn't out my skin or leave it oily. I have Combination skin.

I love this product and had purchased it before but I think it's old. I cannot squeeze it out without putting two hands together on it.
great cleanser, combine with my facial cleansing towel. Removes my makeup and skin feels very refreshed. Sometimes use as a body wash
I love this cleanser. I have been using it for many years. It is soft and gentle to my skin.
I love this cleanser. It's gentle enough for my extremely sensitive skin, but still cleanses well.

A+ Best cleanser! I use this 2 per day AM and PM. Leaves my face clean and smooth.

avis.titre: Great way to cleanse make-up away

This is my favorite cleanser because it cleans my combination skin well and leaves it feeling soft & refreshed.

This facial cleanser is the only product that i wash my face with, alternating with the "pink tube". I live how such a small dollip of product turns into a handful of suds. I like how it leaves my face feeling moisturized. Its a very gentle cleanser, never burning my eyes.

avis.titre: Best face cleanser I've ever used!
avis.texte: It only takes a pea size of this cleanser to truly cleanse your skin, but it feels so gentle! After I wash my face I use a white towel to pat dry. After using this product, there is never any makeup left on my face & my skin feels deeply cleansed but never stripped. In fact, my face feels softer! I love this product!
I love this cleanser. It foams up nicely and makes my skin feel clean.
I rotate my cleansers. I really like the Lancome Creme Radiance in the spring and fall as my skin doesn't feel tight after using it. It feels soft to be honest. I am 50 to 55, Asian.

Perfect for sensitive skin. I would recommend this to everyone.
Good cleanser, a bit dry but moisturizer will fix the problem.
I love this product. I love that it washes away all makeup and leave my face feeling youthful.
Makes skin very soft and radiant . Have been using this product for many years

avis.titre: Nice for people with more combination to oily skin
avis.texte: I have been a fan of the pink mouse cleanser for a while. I wanted to try this blue one out to see if it was as good as the pink one. However, personally for me, pink one is much better for me. I am in my 40s and my skin although used to be combination is becoming more and more dry. So I would say this is more suited for true combination to oily skin then dryer or more mature skin. The clean feel after washing my face is too strong to use everyday. But the pink one I love to use everyday and it does not feel strong.
I had been to a dermatologist about my troubled forehead and he prescribed a medication that was harsh. Instead I tried this wash and have been thrilled with results. Been using for years.

I've used this product for 15 years! No other face wash compares. I'm close to 40 & people ask me about my 20 yo complexion. My secret is this Facewash followed by your favorite high quality moisturizer
Cleans and exfoileates at the same time. Makes my face feel soft and refreshed.

I've been using this for years! Always had trouble with breaking out until I started using this cleanser and the Lancome Tonique Radiance Clarifying Toner containing Rose and Lotus Flower Extract! Love them both!
This cleanser is really good at removing makeup and it's a great value because it's very concentrated and lasts a long time.
Have used this face wash for years and I love it because it's very gentle on my skin and effective skin care.
Love the product. Helps with pores and leaves skin feeling really clean. I've been using it for years!
Love this cleanser. It's very gentle but is able to clean my skin very well, even my mascara comes right off. It also lasts because only a little bit of cleanser is needed.
I have been continuously using this cleanser with the scrub and I see significant results. My face appears to be brighter and I not only look clean but also feel clean with this product.

I have used this for years. Recently, as I've been trying clean makeup due to a cancer diagnosis, I've realized nothing compares and just all what it had been doing for my pores, fine lines and cleanliness!
I feel my face do greasy and clean after one wash no need to repeat.
Absolutely love how this cleansing creme makes my face feel so soft and smooth.

Another Lancome product I've been using for years! I love the gentle creaminess that turns into lather with added water. No harsh chemicals, you can open your eyes with a full lather on and no burning. I keep one by the sink and one in the shower to be sure I have it at hand.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again, and again

My face never feels tight or dry after cleansing with this product. I love it!
Make your skin os so super soft I love it so much will buy again
I always use Lancôme for face wash as it is mild but keeps my face clean.
I like the creamy foamy structure. Cleans very well. Gentle for the face. I have been using it for a long time.
I've used this product for many years. Very pleased with the gentleness. It also leaves my skin feeling very clean and soft.
I like the way this product feels like a cream, but it foams to really feel like a cleanser.
I use it every night to remove my makeup and it leaves my skin very clean and fresh.
I have tried many other face cream cleaners and none compare to Creme Radiance Cream to Foam in getting my face completely clean of makeup
